★★★★★Big case. Good airflow. Preinstalled fans.
Fans came pre installed and wired to their hub. Easy and plenty of room. Side panels are like cabinet doors. They have pegs that slide easily into pressure locks. Theron · 2026-03-16 · via amazon
★★★★★Excellent case: high quality, spacious, and silent
The Flux Pro is hands down the best case I have ever personally come across in years of building PCs for myself, friends and family. - Nicely shipped, comes in a box with molded foam padding holding the case securely in place. - Includes plenty of screws etc. for various arrangements, multiple SSDs, as well as a nice transparent plastic screw case/organizer with movable separators. - Spacious and easy to build in. Plenty of space for large CPU coolers and GPUs. Comfortably fits Noctua NH-D15 with room to spare. - Great options for cable management inside the case with preinstalled loop straps for cable bundling. Existing cables inside the case (e.g. for front panel) are very well managed also. - Included fans are very efficient and high quality, getting 6 of them included makes this case not only great quality but also a great value. They come pre-installed and hooked up to a small daughter board near the front/top panel with nicely routed cabling. - Excellent and quiet air cooling performance. Using AMD 9800X3D and NH-D15 cooler, Sapphire AMD 7900XT GPU with default curves on the case fans, baseline 40% on the NH-D15 up to about 60C and an aggressive curve ramping quickly to 100% by 80C. The resulting system is totally silent for basic use and nearly all gaming loads; fans only become audible under very CPU heavy loads like code or shader compilation. Most of the time the GPU fan (and some GPU coil whine...) are the loudest thing in the system. I rarely ever see the CPU above about 65C, and even maxing out all cores I simply can't get it much above 76C with instant peak of 81-82C before fans catch up. Of course the 9800 and Noctua also get credit for this, but it's truly impressive how quiet it is. - The HDD rack in the lower bay is easy to completely remove if you aren't using it, for slightly better airflow from the two lower fans pulling up through the bottom of the case. - Power supply is easy to install with plenty of room for dealing with cables thanks to the large mostly empty lower bay. - The mesh front panel and small holes on the bottom panel do a good job of minimizing dust in the case. Not perfect, but very good given the outstanding airflow of the case. The spacious interior also makes it easy to clean. - The USB ports and power button on the top/front panel are solid and firmly mounted. - The CPU/GPU temperature display works well (with required software installed) and is kind of cool. - I didn't really care about the wood accent when I purchased, but it looks quite good and is a nice "premium" touch. - No quality issues with my unit of any kind. A small nit, but depending on the arrangement of your motherboard, the cables from the front panel may be very slightly on the short side. Not really a problem, but for one of the cables from the front panel I had to basically force a shortest path diagonally across the back of the motherboard (ignoring most cable management) to be able to reach the far left side of the bottom edge of the mobo.
David · 2025-04-01 · via amazon
★★★★★Great case, wonderful aesthetic, and even better airflow.
Absolutely wonderful. It's genuinely a beautiful case where functionality and artistic sense come together. The aesthetic is perfect with the wood frame on the front giving it a nice classy feel without being over the top. The case fits my ATX motherboard + RTX 4090, and a 360mm AIO with ease. It does wonders to help with temps, the larger size and design (upgrading from a Corsair 5000D which I liked, but struggled with high temps) guarantees good airflow and the fans it come with work great from the get-go, no extra fan purchases are really needed unless you absolutely need the quietest of the quietest fans. Noise level is pretty standard, but definitely not silent. However it may be possible to make it very quiet with some tweaks in the BIOS. There's a little rubber piece that was missing where the PSU sits I think (it has been a while since I purchased) but in the end it's not that big of a deal, my satisfaction with how it performed and the ease of working with it far outweighed that little minus. Overall, this is it for me, my forever case. I have no need nor want to ever use another case. I'm so satisfied with this one. I don't think it's possible for this case to not be a good purchase, unless it simply didn't fit your needs.

Gregx0ry · 2026-01-10 · via amazon
★★★★★Blown away by the engineering and quality!
This is without question the best case I've ever built a system in, after 25 years of building computers. Everything was thought out extremely well and everything has a purpose. The ventilation into the shroud area is present front, back and bottom, with reverse flow fans to draw some of that air up to the GPU. The top comes completely off for full access to placing fans, radiators, or even hooking things up through the top while installing components. The top and rear have a sliding track that you can move your fans along to be in the location you want, and the whole 3 fan assembly up front has 5 different positions to move, up or down. The altered direction PSU is a game changer for installing and removing cables and for cable management. All the cable routing can easily be done in pre-made paths that are all velcro'd. I didn't have to use one zip tie and ended up with the best cable management I've ever had in probably 30 builds thanks to the multitude of perfectly located cutouts and the velcro cable tracks. Included is a quality screw box with strong, good quality metal screws of all the types you will need to build your system. All are in labeled packets. I had no problem fitting any of my components in. Every piece has room and air around it and my system stays much cooler than it ever did with a 4070 Ti Super and a12900k. The case is rather heavy, so be aware of that before you lift your completed system. It is solid steel for the most part and I found very little if any flex, even with both sides and the top off. I highly recommend this beautiful, well-designed case. It is on the more expensive side, but you'll likely keep it for many years.
